title: MinaFountain
tagline: MinaFountain introduces a new way to engage users by blending gaming and blockchain rewards. Players compete in games like Sudoku, and winners are rewarded with MinaFountain tokens on the Polygon network.
description:
Play, Solve, and Mine – Gamified Rewards on MinaFountain

MinaFountain is a decentralized gaming platform designed to gamify the blockchain experience by allowing users to play skill-based games and earn rewards in the form of MinaFountain tokens. The platform’s first offering is Sudoku, a globally recognized puzzle game. By solving puzzles, users compete for mining rights, which enable them to mint MinaFountain tokens on the Polygon network.

This project aims to create a unique intersection of gaming, blockchain technology, and decentralized token mining. The goal is to onboard a wide range of users into the blockchain ecosystem, making it more accessible and engaging through interactive and rewarding gameplay.
how_its_made:
Protokit + Svelte (Explorer) + Nextjs

Tailwind CSS: For rapid styling and ensuring a clean, modern interface.

Polygon (MATIC): Chosen for its low fees and high transaction throughput, making it perfect for handling frequent token transfers.
Mina Protocol: As the foundational ecosystem, providing lightweight, privacy-preserving blockchain solutions for future scalability.
